goal: Every attempt records the resolved base commit SHA of its workspace and the effective agent model id actually passed to the SDK.

constraints: Spec FR-11 is authoritative: pick ONE documented location (agent_context_json on the attempt or the AttemptStarted payload) and record both values there
The model id is the post-resolution value (after --model flag, flywheel.toml [agent].model, and default are applied), not the configured string
The base SHA is the commit the worktree was actually created from, resolved at workspace prep time
Both values must survive domain-event replay
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify
non_goals: No snapshotting of flywheel.toml or prompt templates
No schema columns -- this rides in existing JSON fields
edge_cases: Direct flywheel-core invocations without a worktree (no base SHA available) must record the model id and omit the SHA cleanly rather than fabricating one
